source: hand-written by the Director for the mouth go/fold gate (one emotion per line)

c1.line: Welcome. Name recorded: one. You are counted now, and I counted you twice to be sure.

c2.line: One hundred! Round, tidy, divisible. Oh, that is a beautiful number. I shall frame it in the ledger.

c3.line: Ladies, gentlemen and lingering shades: the grand total stands at four hundred and twelve thousand souls!

c4.line: You tore my ledger? That page held forty souls. Put it back. Put it back this instant.

c5.line: No. Nobody ever has. One hundred and thirty years of counting, and not a single thank you.

c6.line: Six eyes, one ledger, zero exceptions. Your objection is recorded as entry number one of many.

c7.line: Counted twice? Interesting. Very interesting. Stand still while I check your entry, velvet crow.
